# Test-ZbxMediaType

## SYNOPSIS

Sends a test message through a media type.

## SYNTAX

```
Test-ZbxMediaType [-MediaType] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMediaType>> -SendTo <string> [-Subject <string>] [-Message <string>] [-Parameter <object>] [-Server <DnsEndPoint[]>] [-Tls <ZabbixTlsMode>] [-PskIdentity <string>] [-Psk <SecureString>] [-Certificate <string>] [-CertificateKey <string>] [-CertificateAuthority <string>] [-CertificateRevocationList <string>] [-ServerIssuer <string>] [-ServerSubject <string>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Test-ZbxMediaType cmdlet asks the server's trapper to send a test message through the media type in -MediaType to the recipient in -SendTo, as the Test button of the frontend's media type list does (alert.send). It writes what the media type returned, such as a webhook's response; a media type that fails ends with the server's error. It needs the trapper in -Server or the connection's, and -WhatIf shows the message without sending it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Send a test message through a media type

```powershell
Test-ZbxMediaType -MediaType 'Service status' -SendTo 'ops' -Subject 'Test' -Message 'Hello from PowerShell' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
```

The server runs the media type once (the frontend's "Test" button; alert.send on the server's trapper port, given with -Server). The result is what the media type returned.

### Example 2: Preview a test of the e-mail media type without sending

```powershell
Test-ZbxMediaType -MediaType 'Email' -SendTo 'jdoe@example.com' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051' -WhatIf
```

ConfirmImpact is Medium; -WhatIf prints what would be sent and to whom, and sends nothing.

### Example 3: Test a media type read with Get-ZbxMediaType

```powershell
$mediaType = Get-ZbxMediaType -Name 'Service status'
Test-ZbxMediaType -MediaType $mediaType -SendTo 'ops' -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
```

-MediaType also takes the object; the test fails with the server's error text when the media type does not work.
